_doc: #1093 Which apps' network_security_config.xml carry a GENERATED cleartext allowlist for the fleet's `.app` mesh hosts, and which of the declared services each one reaches. The hosts come from ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints (every service whose mesh_scheme is http), so no host is hand-listed anywhere; a public host is never cleartext. `services` is "*" (all) or the ids this app talks to. Written by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-fleet-nsc.py write, held by libs:fleet-endpoints' FleetHostGuardTest.
